external_candidate.purpose: Activation capture/patching and causal-intervention mechanisms as a potential falsifier/tool donor for F2-WP-507 GWT uptake and later local J-Space causal evidence.

fusion_reentry: F2 advanced repeatedly after the fusion; exact duplicate-sensitive objectives for AgentTop E3, seed009 E1, WP507 scouts, pyvene E2 and uniprof E3 were observed and routed around before selecting this distinct candidate.
hypothesis: TransformerLens activation caching, hooks and activation patching may provide a model-internal causal-intervention donor for proving or falsifying whether selected/broadcast F2/J-Space signals causally affect a local transformer model, without granting truth authority to the probe itself.
counterhypothesis: TransformerLens may be too architecture-specific/heavy, may not support the target ~0.8B runtime cleanly, and could duplicate pyvene or custom hooks without improving F2 causal evidence quality.
